That template undermines natural, source-grounded discussion. No current authorized personal LinkedIn comment/impression metric baseline was demonstrated; older personal metric snapshots were from September 2026. Reject clear 'typ JA/reageer met EENS', like/share/tag/follow bait in original personal copy and last-mile gates without banning sincere specific questions. Preserve all independent source, review, SHA, provider, identity and privacy gates. Only label performance PROVEN from real individual member metrics in original provider+Heartbeat lineage. Regression MUST verify that both the original writer and all builder/observational repair prompts do not restore forced question endings or rigid paragraph/word counts.
